title: Whole-Head Cocktail Party fNIRS
description: This dataset comprises whole-head functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) recordings from 38 subjects performing spatial-attention tasks in a cocktail-party paradigm with simultaneous eye-tracking. The study includes both overt attention tasks with eye movements and covert auditory attention tasks with central fixation, along with baseline and resting-state conditions. The fNIRS system captured 1134 measurement channels (56 sources, 144 detectors) at approximately 8.99 Hz sampling rate, providing comprehensive hemodynamic measurements during naturalistic audiovisual stimulus processing.
methods_description: Whole-head fNIRS recordings were acquired using 56 sources and 144 detectors yielding 1134 measurement channels at ~8.99 Hz sampling rate. Simultaneous eye-tracking was performed during multiple task conditions: overt spatial attention with eye movements to audiovisual stimuli, covert auditory attention with central fixation, eye-movement-only baseline, resting-state with central fixation, and video-attention tasks. No anatomical imaging data were collected.
